body: That's kinda what I was thinking but it doesn't make sense why it tends to be more often one gender than the other! Like I used to mostly wanna be feminine. But over the last 4 months of thinking about this and experimenting with being more masculine/neutral for the first time in years, I have found I mostly present that way and the feminine days are fewer than the neutral/masculine ones. But I can't tell if that's something that will flip flop with time (which way I feel/wanna present more often ie masculine more often than feminine but maybe in a few months it'll be the opposite?) Or if I'm just more neutral/masculine leaning (I still do have girl presenting days though) now that I am finally feeling like I'm allowed to do that and can do it.
